description:
The Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division intends to procure a Hydraulic Power Unit (HPU) on a sole source basis from Airline Hydraulics Co.  The proposed contract action is for supplies or services for which the Government intends to solicit and award with only one source under authority of FAR 13.106(b).

Any questions regarding this notice should be emailed to: zachary.f.mccurry.civ@us.navy.mil

Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
